summary: A large patient count, a WhatsApp option and a wide menu are strengths, but exposed PHP warnings and dead menu headings appear to cost you patients.

findings.problem: The team section shows raw PHP warnings, including 'Warning: Trying to access array offset on value of type null' and a server file path.
findings.cost: Technical errors on a medical page look careless and expose server details.
findings.fix: A clean team section with no errors.

findings.problem: The Treatments and Conditions menu items link to #, and categories such as Breasts and Digestive Health contain only a View All link.
findings.cost: Patients browsing treatments hit dead ends.
findings.fix: Working menus and finished category pages.

findings.problem: The body phone link is tel:0207436441, one digit short of the footer number, and the opening hours differ between the body and the footer.
findings.cost: A patient who taps to call may reach the wrong line, and mixed hours cost visits.
findings.fix: One checked number and one set of hours.

findings.problem: Over 61,329 patients agree appears twice, Mons Pubic Lift is misspelled, and image text reads 'image title' and 'alt'.
findings.cost: Repeated lines, typos and placeholders weaken a premium brand.
findings.fix: Proofread copy and real image descriptions.

redesign: A clean team section and working menus.
One checked phone number, hours and a direct enquiry form.
Proofread copy with real image descriptions.
